# `arcane` command reference

<!-- Generated by `arcane docs`; do not edit. tests/test_cli.cpp fails when this file drifts. -->

`arcane` is the headless authoring command line. It links the same command registry as the tests and
has no window, GL or audio dependency. Nothing starts a server.

## Usage

```
arcane [--project DIR] [--module PATH] [--scene FILE] [--dry-run] [--pretty] <group> <verb> [args]
arcane batch FILE|-
arcane docs
```

- `--project DIR` is the project folder (default `.`); `--module PATH` replaces the project's native module
  (used by build-tree tests); `--scene FILE` edits another scene than `main_scene`.
- Arguments are `--name value` (dashes become underscores) or `--name=value`; the listed positional
  arguments may be given without a flag. Strings are taken as text; every other argument and every
  untyped one (`--value`) is JSON, so quote it for the shell: `--value '180.0'`, `--value '"text"'`,
  `--value '[1,2]'`. `--args '{...}'` supplies several arguments as one JSON object. Booleans may be bare
  (`--overwrite`). Verbs with an underscore are written with a dash: `project settings-set`
  (also accepted as `project settings set`).
- `--json` is accepted and changes nothing: the output is always JSON. `--pretty` indents it.
- `--dry-run` runs everything and writes nothing (commands that write files immediately refuse it).

## Output and exit status

One JSON object on stdout: `{"ok":true, ...result}` or
`{"ok":false,"error":{"code","message","file","path","hint"}}` (absent fields are null). A one-line
diagnostic goes to stderr. `arcane docs` prints this reference as raw Markdown.

| Exit | Meaning | Codes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | Success, including no-op | |
| 1 | Other failure | `AUDIO_UNAVAILABLE` |
| 2 | Usage or argument error | `USAGE`, `UNKNOWN_COMMAND`, `ARGS_INVALID` |
| 3 | File/IO or project not found | `PROJECT_NOT_FOUND`, `IO_ERROR` |
| 4 | Schema, reference or validation error | `SCHEMA_INVALID`, `VALUE_INVALID`, `PROPERTY_UNKNOWN`, `NODE_NOT_FOUND`, `COMPONENT_NOT_FOUND`, `COMPONENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN`, `REPLAY_DIVERGED`; `validate` with problems; `fmt --check` with differences |
| 5 | Conflict, ambiguous selector, concurrent edit | `CONFLICT`, `SELECTOR_AMBIGUOUS` |
| 6 | Module load or execution failure | `MODULE_LOAD_FAILED`, `MODULE_FAILURE` |
| 7 | Unsupported version or feature | `UNSUPPORTED_VERSION`, `DRY_RUN_UNSUPPORTED` |

## Selectors

Node: `id:42` (preferred, stable) or `path:/Root/Player` (names must be unique at each level, otherwise
`SELECTOR_AMBIGUOUS`). Component: its integer id, or a type name attached to the node exactly once.

## Writes and safety

Every scene command saves the scene file by writing a temporary file next to it and renaming it, after
serializing and re-validating in memory; a failure leaves the old file. If the scene file changed on disk
since it was read the command fails with `CONFLICT` (an edit check, not a lock). The CLI keeps no undo
history; use git. Atomicity is per command, not per batch.

## Batch

`arcane batch FILE|-` reads one JSON object per line, `{"command":"prop.set","args":{...}}` (command
names use dots; blank lines are skipped), and runs them in order against one open project, saving after
each. It stops at the first failure and reports `failed_line`, the error and the results so far. With
`--dry-run` the commands run cumulatively in memory and nothing is saved.

## Coverage

Covered: project, scene files, nodes, components, typed properties, prefabs, atlases, transitions, saves,
replay, bench, audio probe, validate, fmt, migrate, schema, docs, batch. Not available (no command yet):
tilemap/tileset editing, HUD, input maps, animation clip authoring beyond `atlas make-clip`, physics
authoring beyond properties, asset import, `run`, `export`, `render`, `test`. The editor does not use
these commands for its edits yet (docs/editor-command-inventory.md).

## Commands

### `arcane atlas make-clip`

Write an animation clip file whose frames are atlas regions (in the given order). The sprite using the clip still points its texture at the atlas image.

Writes files immediately; `--dry-run` is refused (`DRY_RUN_UNSUPPORTED`).

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--atlas` | string | yes |  |
| `--clip` | string | yes |  |
| `--frame-seconds` | number | no |  |
| `--loop` | boolean | no |  |
| `--name` | string | no |  |
| `--overwrite` | boolean | no |  |
| `--regions` | array | yes |  |

### `arcane atlas pack`

Pack every PNG under a project folder into one atlas image plus canonical atlas metadata. Deterministic: the same inputs give the same bytes. Writes both files at once.

Writes files immediately; `--dry-run` is refused (`DRY_RUN_UNSUPPORTED`).

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--atlas` | string | yes |  |
| `--folder` | string | yes |  |
| `--image` | string | no |  |
| `--max-size` | integer | no |  |
| `--padding` | integer | no |  |

### `arcane atlas regions`

List the regions of an atlas file with pixel rectangles and UV rects [u0,v0,u1,v1]; with `name`, only that region.

Read only.

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--atlas` | string | yes |  |
| `--name` | string | no |  |

### `arcane audio backend`

Report which audio backend a visible session would use. By default no device is opened and the result is the null backend; with probe_device=true a device is opened briefly and the fallback reason is reported.

Read only.

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--probe-device` | boolean | no |  |

### `arcane bench run`

Run the headless benchmark (no window, GL or audio): sprite nodes, particle emitters and falling bodies stepped for N fixed frames. Returns an arcane.bench v1 document; timings vary per machine.

Read only.

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bodies` | integer | no |  |
| `--emitters` | integer | no |  |
| `--frames` | integer | no |  |
| `--particles-per-emitter` | integer | no |  |
| `--sprites` | integer | no |  |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--index` | integer | yes |  |

### `arcane hud set`

Set one field of the HUD element at `index`. Common: id, anchor (TopLeft..BottomRight), offset_x, offset_y. text: text, font_scale, color; image: texture_asset (0 = none), uv [u0,v0,u1,v1], width, height, tint; bar: width, height, fraction, fill, background; button: label, width, height, font_scale, enabled, normal, hover, pressed, disabled, text_color. Colors are [r,g,b,a].

Edits the open scene (hud.* edit project.json) and saves each file atomically; `--dry-run` shows the result and saves nothing.

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--field` | string | yes |  |
| `--index` | integer | yes |  |
| `--value` | json | yes |  |

### `arcane prefab override`

Set one property of a prefab instance node and record it as an override of the prefab value. Without 'component' the property is a node field (name, position, rotation_radians, scale). Setting the prefab's own value drops the override.

Edits the open scene (hud.* edit project.json) and saves each file atomically; `--dry-run` shows the result and saves nothing.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--component` | string | no |  |

| `--property` | string | yes |  |
| `--value` | json | yes |  |

Writes files immediately; `--dry-run` is refused (`DRY_RUN_UNSUPPORTED`).

| `--node` | string | yes |  |
| `--overwrite` | boolean | no |  |

### `arcane replay run`

Replay a recording headless on a copy of the open scene (fixed timestep, physics, the project's input actions) and hash the scene state after every frame. With `expected` (a trace file) fails with REPLAY_DIVERGED naming the first divergent frame; with `trace_out` writes the trace (arcane.replay_trace v1). Game-module on_update is not called. Same build and platform only.

Writes files immediately; `--dry-run` is refused (`DRY_RUN_UNSUPPORTED`).

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--expected` | string | no |  |
| `--recording` | string | yes |  |
| `--trace-out` | string | no |  |

### `arcane replay save`

Write an input recording (arcane.replay v1, docs/formats/replay.md): fixed rate, frame count, optional seed and the input changes per fixed frame. The events array is validated exactly like a recording file.

Writes files immediately; `--dry-run` is refused (`DRY_RUN_UNSUPPORTED`).

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--events` | array | no |  |
| `--file` | string | yes |  |
| `--fixed-hz` | integer | no |  |
| `--frames` | integer | yes |  |
| `--seed` | integer | no |  |

### `arcane save migrate`

Upgrade a save slot to `to` (default: the project's save.data_version) in one declarative step: `rename` {old:new}, `remove` [keys], `defaults` {key:value} (only for keys still missing), applied in that order, then data_version is set. Writes atomically; any failure writes nothing. Games with code migrations use SaveMigration.

Writes files immediately; `--dry-run` is refused (`DRY_RUN_UNSUPPORTED`).

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--defaults` | object | no |  |
| `--dir` | string | no |  |
| `--remove` | array | no |  |
| `--rename` | object | no |  |
| `--slot` | string | yes |  |
| `--to` | integer | no |  |

### `arcane save remove`

Remove one key from a save slot. Writes atomically at once; fails if the key does not exist.

Writes files immediately; `--dry-run` is refused (`DRY_RUN_UNSUPPORTED`).

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--dir` | string | no |  |
| `--key` | string | yes |  |
| `--slot` | string | yes |  |

### `arcane save set`

Set one value (boolean, 32-bit integer, number or string) in a save slot, creating the slot if `create` is true. Writes atomically at once; the data version is kept.

Writes files immediately; `--dry-run` is refused (`DRY_RUN_UNSUPPORTED`).

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--create` | boolean | no |  |
| `--dir` | string | no |  |
| `--key` | string | yes |  |
| `--slot` | string | yes |  |
| `--value` | json | yes |  |

### `arcane scene list`

List the scene files of the project with their format.

Read only.

No arguments.

### `arcane scene new`

Create an empty scene file (canonical scene v2); never overwrites unless overwrite is set.

Writes files; honors `--dry-run`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--overwrite` | boolean | no |  |
| `--path` | string | yes | 1 |

### `arcane scene query`

Summarize the open scene: node and component counts, component types in use, next id.

Read only.

No arguments.

### `arcane scene restore`

Internal inverse of structural edits: replaces the open scene with a canonical scene v2 text. Node and component pointers from before the call are invalid afterwards.

Edits the open scene (hud.* edit project.json) and saves each file atomically; `--dry-run` shows the result and saves nothing.

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--text` | string | yes |  |

### `arcane scene tree`

Print the node hierarchy of the open scene (ids, names, components); `node` starts at a subtree.

Read only.

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--depth` | integer | no |  |
| `--node` | string | no |  |

### `arcane schema`

Print a static JSON schema (type), a command's argument schema (command) or a component's registered properties (component); without arguments list the types.

Read only.

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--command` | string | no |  |
| `--component` | string | no |  |
| `--type` | string | no |  |

### `arcane tilemap add-layer`

Append an empty layer; the result names its index.

Edits the open scene (hud.* edit project.json) and saves each file atomically; `--dry-run` shows the result and saves nothing.

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--node` | string | yes |  |

### `arcane tilemap dump-csv`

Dump one layer as CSV (one row per grid row, tile ids, 0 = empty). With `file` (project-relative), also writes it there at once.

Writes files immediately; `--dry-run` is refused (`DRY_RUN_UNSUPPORTED`).

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--file` | string | no |  |
| `--layer` | integer | no |  |
| `--node` | string | yes |  |

### `arcane tilemap erase`

Clear one cell (tile 0).

Edits the open scene (hud.* edit project.json) and saves each file atomically; `--dry-run` shows the result and saves nothing.

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--layer` | integer | no |  |
| `--node` | string | yes |  |
| `--x` | integer | yes |  |
| `--y` | integer | yes |  |

### `arcane tilemap fill-rect`

Fill the inclusive cell rectangle x0,y0..x1,y1 with a tile (0 = erase). Corners may be given in any order and must be inside the grid.

Edits the open scene (hud.* edit project.json) and saves each file atomically; `--dry-run` shows the result and saves nothing.

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--layer` | integer | no |  |
| `--node` | string | yes |  |
| `--tile` | integer | yes |  |
| `--x0` | integer | yes |  |
| `--x1` | integer | yes |  |
| `--y0` | integer | yes |  |
| `--y1` | integer | yes |  |

### `arcane tilemap get`

Read one cell (tile id, 0 = empty).

Read only.

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--layer` | integer | no |  |
| `--node` | string | yes |  |
| `--x` | integer | yes |  |
| `--y` | integer | yes |  |

### `arcane tilemap import-csv`

Write CSV tile ids into a layer starting at cell (x, y) (default 0,0). Give the text as `csv` or read it from a project-relative `file`. Rows must be the same length, fit the grid and use valid tile ids; nothing changes otherwise.

Edits the open scene (hud.* edit project.json) and saves each file atomically; `--dry-run` shows the result and saves nothing.

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--csv` | id or name | no |  |
| `--file` | string | no |  |
| `--layer` | integer | no |  |
| `--node` | string | yes |  |
| `--x` | integer | no |  |
| `--y` | integer | no |  |

Describe a Tilemap component: size, cell size, layers and the tileset it points at.

Read only.

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--node` | string | yes |  |

### `arcane tilemap paint`

Paint one cell with a tile id (layer defaults to 0).

Edits the open scene (hud.* edit project.json) and saves each file atomically; `--dry-run` shows the result and saves nothing.

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--layer` | integer | no |  |
| `--node` | string | yes |  |
| `--tile` | integer | yes |  |
| `--x` | integer | yes |  |
| `--y` | integer | yes |  |

### `arcane tilemap set-cells`

Set many cells at once: cells is a list of {layer, x, y, tile}. All are validated first; nothing changes if any is invalid. This is also the inverse of every other cell edit.

Edits the open scene (hud.* edit project.json) and saves each file atomically; `--dry-run` shows the result and saves nothing.

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--cells` | array | yes |  |
| `--node` | string | yes |  |

### `arcane tilemap terrain-paint`

Paint (or with erase=true clear) a cell with auto-tiling: the tile is picked from the tileset's rule for `terrain` by its N/E/S/W neighbours, and the neighbours of that terrain are re-picked (the editor's terrain brush).

Edits the open scene (hud.* edit project.json) and saves each file atomically; `--dry-run` shows the result and saves nothing.

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--erase` | boolean | no |  |
| `--layer` | integer | no |  |
| `--node` | string | yes |  |
| `--terrain` | integer | yes |  |
| `--x` | integer | yes |  |
| `--y` | integer | yes |  |

### `arcane tileset create`

Create a tileset file. `texture` is an image under assets/ (project-relative path, e.g. assets/tiles.png) or a raw asset id. Fails if the file exists unless overwrite=true.

Writes files immediately; `--dry-run` is refused (`DRY_RUN_UNSUPPORTED`).

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--columns` | integer | yes |  |
| `--overwrite` | boolean | no |  |
| `--texture` | id or name | yes |  |
| `--tile-count` | integer | yes |  |
| `--tile-height` | integer | yes |  |
| `--tile-width` | integer | yes |  |
| `--tileset` | string | yes |  |

### `arcane tileset info`

Show a tileset file: sheet layout, per-tile solid/terrain flags and terrain rules.

Read only.

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--tileset` | string | yes |  |

### `arcane tileset remove-rule`

Remove the auto-tile rule of a terrain.

Writes files immediately; `--dry-run` is refused (`DRY_RUN_UNSUPPORTED`).

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--terrain` | integer | yes |  |
| `--tileset` | string | yes |  |

### `arcane tileset set-rule`

Add or replace the auto-tile rule of a terrain: `tiles` is 16 tile ids indexed by neighbour mask (N=1 E=2 S=4 W=8; 0 = no tile). Run tileset.validate afterwards to check the tiles are marked with the terrain.

Writes files immediately; `--dry-run` is refused (`DRY_RUN_UNSUPPORTED`).

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--terrain` | integer | yes |  |
| `--tiles` | array | yes |  |
| `--tileset` | string | yes |  |

### `arcane tileset set-tile`

Set the solid flag and/or terrain of tile `tile` (1-based id). Writes the file at once.

Writes files immediately; `--dry-run` is refused (`DRY_RUN_UNSUPPORTED`).

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--solid` | boolean | no |  |
| `--terrain` | integer | no |  |
| `--tile` | integer | yes |  |
| `--tileset` | string | yes |  |

### `arcane tileset validate`

Check a tileset's content: rule tiles inside tile_count, rule tiles marked with their terrain, duplicate or empty rules. ok=false (exit 4) lists the problems; the file is never changed.

Read only.

| Argument | Type | Required | Positional |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--tileset` | string | yes |  |

### `arcane transition get`

Read the authored scene-transition settings (fade seconds and colour) from project.json.

No arguments.

Change the authored scene-transition settings in project.json; omitted fields keep their value. Writes at once.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--color` | array | no |  |

| `--fade-out-seconds` | number | no |  |
